home.automate.lead: Cashly lives where you already are on your iPhone.
home.automate.point1: Wallet capture: a Shortcuts automation sends every Apple Pay purchase to Cashly
home.automate.point2: Widgets on the Home Screen and Lock Screen
home.automate.point3: A New Expense control for Control Center and the Action button
home.automate.point4: Siri: "How much is left in Groceries in Cashly"
home.automate.title: Record without opening the app.
home.closing.lead: Free on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
home.closing.title: Make this the month you know.
home.comingSoon: Mac and Vision Pro coming soon
home.data.lead: There is no Cashly server holding your data and no bank password to hand over. Nothing to sign up for, nothing to leak.
home.data.point1: Sync across your iPhone and iPad with your own iCloud
home.data.point2: Export a backup or a spreadsheet anytime, free
home.data.point3: Face ID lock and a discreet mode that blurs amounts
home.data.title: Your money is nobody else's business.
home.devices.ipadLabel: Cashly on iPad showing history and budgets side by side
home.devices.lead: Your months follow you through your own iCloud. On iPad, details open beside the list instead of covering it, and the Mac app works the same way when it arrives.
home.devices.macLabel: Cashly for Mac, coming soon, with a transaction open in the inspector
home.devices.title: Made for iPhone and iPad. Mac and Vision Pro are next.
home.faq.bank.a: No. Cashly never asks for bank passwords. You record in a few taps, or let a Shortcuts automation capture Apple Pay purchases for you.
home.faq.bank.q: Do I need to connect my bank?
home.faq.cancel.a: Everything you recorded stays readable, editable and exportable. Only the Pro features stop.
home.faq.cancel.q: What happens if I cancel Pro?
home.faq.devices.a: iPhone and iPad today, with Mac and Apple Vision Pro coming soon. In English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Russian, with any currency.
home.faq.free.a: Recording, editing, budgets, the Journey, widgets, Siri, iCloud sync and export are free. Pro adds analyses and forecasts, on-device intelligence, automatic backups, imports, the Claude Code connection and exclusive icons and avatars.
home.faq.free.q: What is free and what needs Cashly Pro?
home.faq.storage.a: On your devices and, with iCloud on, in your own private iCloud. There is no Cashly account or server. Read the Privacy Policy.
home.faq.title: Before you download.
home.features.lead: Tap through what Cashly does. Every preview uses the same pieces you will see in the app.
home.features.title: Built for the whole month, not just the receipt.
home.hero.footnote: Free to download. Cashly Pro starts with 7 days free.
home.hero.iphoneLabel: Cashly on iPhone showing the month overview
home.hero.lead: Cashly shows if every budget is on pace, records an expense in three taps and tells you where the month will land. Private by design: no account, no bank login, no ads.
home.hero.title: Know where your money goes before the month ends.
home.journey.lead: Recording, planning and closing the month in the green earn XP. It rewards following your money, never spending more.
home.journey.point1: Fifty levels, with a new title every five
home.journey.point2: Three short missions every week and one challenge a month
home.journey.point3: Streak freezes for the days life gets in the way
home.journey.title: The habit, turned into a game.
home.meta.description: Cashly is the private budget app for iPhone and iPad. Budgets with a pace bar, expenses in three taps, forecasts and a Journey for good money habits. No account, no bank login, no ads.
home.meta.ogDescription: Budgets with a pace bar, expenses in three taps, and your data in your own iCloud. No account, no bank login, no ads.
home.meta.title: Cashly · Know where your money goes before the month ends
home.plan.lead: Every budget has a pace bar: the fill is what you spent, the line is how much of the month has gone by. You see trouble while there is still time to fix it.
home.plan.point1: Budgets by category, for any month
home.plan.point2: Bills and expected income count in the plan from day one
home.plan.point3: Alerts at 80% and 100% of a budget, and a reminder to plan the next month
home.plan.title: Stop finding out on the 30th.
home.pricing.footnote: Monthly or yearly. The yearly plan costs less than seven months of monthly. Cancel anytime in your Apple Account.
home.pricing.free2: Journey, widgets, Siri and Apple Pay capture
home.pricing.free3: iCloud sync on all your devices
home.pricing.free4: Export a backup or spreadsheet anytime
home.pricing.lead: Recording, budgets, the Journey and export are free forever. Cashly Pro adds what turns records into decisions.
home.pricing.pro1: Forecasts, unusual spending and where you can save
home.pricing.pro2: On-device intelligence and the Cashly Summary
home.pricing.pro3: Automatic backups, imports from backups and spreadsheets
home.pricing.title: Free to keep track. Pro to get ahead.
home.record.lead: The amount comes first, big and ready to type. Pick a category and you are done: a coffee takes three taps.
home.record.point1: Tags that cut across categories: Trip, Home, Work
home.record.point2: Installments spread over the months automatically
home.record.point3: Any currency, converted at the rate of the day
home.record.title: So fast you will actually keep doing it.
home.shared.free.text: Creating, inviting and joining don't need Cashly Pro. Your personal profiles stay yours alone.
home.shared.free.title: Free, and the rest stays private
home.shared.invite.text: The other person taps the link, joins from their own iPhone and can start recording.
home.shared.invite.title: Invite by Messages, Mail or AirDrop
home.shared.lead: Each person uses their own iPhone, and what one records shows up for everyone.
home.shared.secure.text: Everything travels through iCloud, end-to-end encrypted with Advanced Data Protection. Cashly never sees it.
home.shared.secure.title: End-to-end encrypted
home.shared.title: One profile for the house, the couple or a trip.
home.shared.what.text: Its own transactions, categories and budgets, with every Cashly screen working the same way.
home.shared.what.title: For what you share
home.split.lead: Add the profiles that split the bill with you. Cashly works out each share and remembers who still owes what.
home.split.point1: Equally, by percentage or by a fixed amount
home.split.point2: Choose who paid, then mark each share as paid or to receive
home.split.point3: Profiles for family, partners and roommates
home.split.title: Shared costs without the awkward math.
home.tips.applePay.text: A Shortcuts automation sends each Apple Pay purchase to Cashly with a suggested category. Accept it once and that merchant arrives ready next time.
home.tips.applePay.title: Apple Pay, recorded for you
home.tips.backTap.text: Set Back Tap to Add Expense and two taps on the back of your iPhone ask what you spent, even inside other apps.
home.tips.backTap.title: Tap the back of your iPhone
home.tips.barColors.text: Green is on track, mustard is close to the limit, rust is over plan.
home.tips.barColors.title: Read the bar colors
home.tips.bills.text: Save a bill as pending with its due date. It counts in the plan from day one, and on the due day a notification lets you mark it paid or postpone it.
home.tips.bills.title: Let bills plan themselves
home.tips.challenge.text: A week without delivery or a spending cap: one challenge a month, on top of three weekly missions worth 25 XP each.
home.tips.challenge.title: Pick a monthly challenge
home.tips.discreet.text: Discreet Mode blurs every amount until you turn it off. Handy on the train or when you show the app to someone.
home.tips.discreet.title: Discreet Mode in public
home.tips.installments.text: Set how many installments and Cashly spreads them over the months, so every budget knows what is already committed.
home.tips.installments.title: Spread an installment purchase
home.tips.lead: Small tricks from the guides inside the app.
home.tips.noSpend.text: A day counts when you record something or tap I Didn't Spend Today. You earn a freeze every 14 days for the days you forget.
home.tips.noSpend.title: No spending counts too
home.tips.threeBudgets.text: Budget only the three categories you spend most on. Add the rest once the habit sticks.
home.tips.threeBudgets.title: Start with three budgets
home.tips.title: Get more out of every month.
home.understand.lead: Cashly reads your history on your device and tells you what matters this month.
home.understand.point1: How much you can still spend per day without going over plan
home.understand.point2: Where the month will land, from your pace and the bills you recorded
home.understand.point3: Unusual spending, recurring charges and where you can save
home.understand.point4: A Cashly Summary written on your device by Apple Intelligence, on supported devices
home.understand.title: Answers, not just charts.

privacy.changes.text: If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above.
privacy.children.text: Cashly is not directed at children under 13 and collects no data from anyone.
privacy.children.title: Children
privacy.collect.text: None. Cashly has no account sign-up, no advertising, no analytics or crash-reporting SDKs and no tracking across apps or websites.
privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
privacy.delete.text: Use Settings › Data and Backup › Delete All Data in Cashly. It also removes the data from your iCloud. You can manage storage for Cashly in your device's iCloud settings. Deleting the app removes local data.
privacy.delete.title: Deleting your data
privacy.device.claude: Claude Code connection (optional). If you turn it on in Settings, Cashly opens a connection on your device or local network so Claude Code on your own computer can read data or propose transactions. Every connection and every import needs your approval in the app. It is off until you enable it.
privacy.device.faceId: Face ID and Touch ID are checked by the system. Cashly only learns whether unlocking succeeded.
privacy.device.notifications: Notifications are scheduled locally on your device.
privacy.device.summary: Cashly Summary and suggestions are computed on your device, including text written by Apple's on-device language model. Your data is not sent to any AI service.
privacy.device.title: On-device features
privacy.diagnostics.text: If you choose to share analytics with app developers in your device settings, Apple may provide us with aggregated, anonymous usage and crash data through App Store Connect.
privacy.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
privacy.lead: Cashly is a personal finance app made by Rafael Escaleira (byescaleira). Your financial data belongs to you: it stays on your devices and in your own iCloud account. We do not run servers that receive it, and we never see it.
privacy.meta.description: How Cashly handles your data: it stays on your devices and in your own iCloud.
privacy.meta.title: Cashly Privacy Policy
privacy.network.purchases: Purchases. Subscriptions and in-app purchases are handled by Apple through the App Store. We do not receive your payment details.
privacy.network.rates: Exchange rates. When you use another currency or the converter, Cashly asks public rate services (the open-source currency API on jsDelivr and Cloudflare Pages, and Frankfurter) for the rates of a date. The request carries only the currencies and the date, never amounts or descriptions. Like any website, these services can see your IP address.
privacy.network.settings: App settings. Cashly reads feature settings from a public iCloud database. Nothing about you is sent.
privacy.network.title: Network requests the app makes
privacy.network.web: Cashly on the Web (optional, Cashly Pro). If you scan the QR code shown at cashly.byescaleira.com/app, Cashly sends a summary of the current month for the current profile, encrypted end to end for the browser whose QR code you scanned, through our bridge at cashly.byescaleira.com. The bridge keeps it for at most 24 hours and cannot read it; only that browser can open it. Disconnect in Settings deletes it right away. The App Store label stays "Data Not Collected" because neither we nor any third party can access the content.
privacy.where.device: On your device. Transactions, budgets, goals, categories, tags, profiles and settings are stored locally.
privacy.where.exports: Files you export. Backups and spreadsheets go only where you choose to save or share them.
privacy.where.icloud: In your iCloud. If iCloud is on, Cashly syncs that data through your private iCloud database, and backups you create are saved to your iCloud Drive. Apple stores it under your Apple Account; we cannot access it.
privacy.where.title: Where your data lives
support.backup.text: Settings › Data and Backup › Export Backup creates a file you can keep anywhere. Import it on any device from the same page.
support.backup.title: How do I back up or move my data?
support.cancel.text: Open Settings › Cashly Pro in the app and tap Manage Subscription, or go to your Apple Account subscriptions. Your data stays readable and exportable after the subscription ends.
support.cancel.title: How do I cancel Cashly Pro?
support.lead: Questions, bugs or ideas? Write to us and include your device and Cashly version (Settings › About Cashly).
support.meta.description: Help with Cashly: contact, subscriptions, iCloud sync and backups.
support.meta.title: Cashly Support
support.restore.text: Tap Restore in the Cashly Pro screen or in the shop item. Purchases are tied to the Apple Account that made them.
support.restore.title: I bought something but don't see it
support.sync.text: Check that you are signed in to the same Apple Account with iCloud Drive on in every device, and that iCloud is on for Cashly. Settings › iCloud in Cashly shows the last sync.
support.sync.title: My data isn't syncing
support.title: Support
terms.advice.text: Cashly helps you organize your money. Its summaries, forecasts, suggestions and exchange rates are estimates for information only and are not financial, tax or investment advice.
terms.advice.title: Not financial advice
terms.changes.text: We may update these terms. The date above shows the latest version.
terms.data.text: Your records are stored on your devices and in your iCloud, as described in the Privacy Policy. You are responsible for keeping backups of anything you cannot lose.
terms.data.title: Your data
terms.lead: Cashly is licensed to you under Apple's Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement. These terms add what is specific to Cashly.
terms.meta.description: Terms of use, subscriptions and in-app purchases for Cashly.
terms.meta.title: Cashly Terms of Use
terms.pro.billing: Cashly Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, billed monthly or yearly at the price shown in the app before you subscribe.
terms.pro.end: When a subscription ends, your data stays yours: everything you recorded remains readable, editable and exportable.
terms.pro.features: Recording, editing, the Journey, widgets, Siri and exporting your data are free. Cashly Pro adds analyses and forecasts, on-device intelligence, automatic backups, imports, the Claude Code connection and exclusive icons and avatars.
terms.pro.renewal: The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account subscription settings.
terms.pro.trial: Eligible new subscribers get a 7-day free trial. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before it ends, the subscription starts and your Apple Account is charged.
terms.purchases.apple: Payments, refunds and restores are handled by Apple under the App Store's terms.
terms.purchases.helps: Journey helps (such as streak freezes) are consumed when used and cannot be restored.
terms.purchases.packs: Icon packs, colors and avatar packs are one-time purchases, restorable on your devices and shareable with Family Sharing.
terms.purchases.title: In-app purchases
